aliases: Galaxy Digital Helios campus / CoreWeave AI site
Galaxy Helios campus / CoreWeave AI site
status_as_of_cutoff: partial live: Galaxy reports all Phase I critical IT load delivered/in service by Q2 2026; Phase II is in site work-construction with TDLR registrations for Helios 2, Helios 3, and Helios 4 and Galaxy reporting HITT mobilized, earthwork complete, and structural foundation work underway. Full county building-permit and water-rights records remain unassembled.
evidence_grade: A- for official Texas state records (TDLR Phase I/II construction registrations; PUCT self-generator registration 70122) and Galaxy/SEC disclosures confirming Phase I delivery and Phase II construction start; B for Phase II capacity and completion timelines, which rest on company disclosure and TDLR planned-completion dates pending county building-permit, inspection, and water-rights records.

actions.body: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
actions.result_or_status: TABS registered Helios Light Speed: a 136,057-square-foot data center and 11,400-square-foot water-treatment building; status Review Complete.
actions.access_caveat: TABS registration is not a county building permit; the water-treatment description is a project scope, not a water-rights approval.

actions.result_or_status: Galaxy Helios I filed an application for self-generator registration for backup diesel generation; later notice of approval identifies the registered facility as 327.2 MW.
actions.access_caveat: Application filing, not approval; confidential attachments are referenced in the docket.

actions.result_or_status: PUCT notice of approval issued self-generator registration number 70122 to Galaxy Helios I LLC for the 327.2-MW Galaxy Helios I LLC Backup Diesel facility.
actions.access_caveat: Official PUCT notice of approval; self-generator registration is not a finding that the data center is energized or fully operational.

actions.body: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
actions.result_or_status: TABS registered Helios 2, Helios 3, and Helios 4 as Galaxy Helios Phase 2 new data-center/office buildings; all three records show Review Complete.
actions.access_caveat: The linked page is Helios 4; Helios 2 and Helios 3 are separate TDLR pages. TABS records are accessibility/construction registrations, not county building permits.
actions.notes: Construction action; TDLR planned completions run from 2027-02-08 to 2027-11-29 and are not actual completion dates.

actions.result_or_status: Galaxy announced completion of Phase I power delivery at Helios, delivering about 200 MW gross power and 133 MW critical IT load to CoreWeave under a 15-year lease; rent commencement began in Q2 2026.
actions.access_caveat: Company announcement; confirms delivered leased capacity, not full-campus buildout.

actions.result_or_status: Galaxy disclosed that Galaxy Helios Data Centers II LLC completed a $3.507 billion senior secured notes offering, with proceeds intended to finance part of a two-building, eight-data-hall Phase II project totaling 400 MW utility capacity and 260 MW critical IT capacity on about 260 acres in Dickens County.
actions.access_caveat: Financing disclosure; use-of-proceeds and project delivery are forward-looking until executed.
actions.notes: Phase II financing and capacity evidence.

actions.result_or_status: Galaxy reported all 133 MW of Phase I critical IT load in service by quarter-end Q2 2026 and stated that Phase II construction had commenced, HITT Contracting was mobilized and on site since April 2026, earthwork was complete, and structural foundation work was underway.
actions.access_caveat: Company operating disclosure; construction-progress details are not independently confirmed by county inspection records.
actions.notes: Status evidence for partial live plus Phase II site work-construction.

capacity_mw.notes: Delivered values are Phase I; contracted values are CoreWeave Phases I-III; approved/potential campus values are company-disclosed and include future/unleased capacity.
